name: create
description: Create a document or a piece of code in the Canvas, next to the chat, where the user reads it, edits it, sees each version and its changes, exports it and previews code. Use it only when the user asks for a document, an app or code to edit or iterate on (a report, a plan, an email, a script, a small web page or React component), instead of writing it in the answer; then answer briefly. Never for a chart or a table of data: those go in the answer, as a mango-chart block or, from run_python, with display_chart and display_table. kind: 'document' (Markdown, without raw HTML: it is never rendered), 'code/python' (the preview runs it in the user's browser with Pyodide: numpy, pandas and matplotlib only, no network, no files), 'code/react' (one component as the default export; Tailwind classes and recharts are available, nothing else is imported) or 'code/html' (one self-contained page, no network). Never put a password in a document, not even an example: Mango masks it when it is stored. At most 256 KiB of text and 20 documents per conversation. The id it returns is what update and comment take.

title.description: A short title for the user (at most 120 characters).

content.description: The whole text of the first version.

name: update
description: Write a new version of a Canvas document of this conversation, on top of its latest version (the user may have edited it: the conversation tells you its current text when they did). Give either the whole new text (always for code) or literal edits for a small, isolated change of a document: each edit finds an exact piece of the text (not a regular expression) and replaces it; a piece that is not there, or is there more than once without all, is refused and nothing changes. The user sees the version and what changed. At most 100 versions per document.

content.description: The whole new text. Omit it when giving edits.

edits.description: Literal edits, applied in order. Omit them when giving content.

find.description: An exact piece of the current text (1 to 4000 characters).

all.description: Replace every time it appears (false: it must appear once).

note.description: What this version changed, in a few words in the user's language (at most 120 characters).

name: comment
description: Comment on pieces of the latest version of a Canvas document of this conversation, without changing it: a question, a doubt or a suggestion the user reads next to the text and resolves. Each quote must be an exact piece of the text. At most 10 comments per call and 20 open per document.

quote.description: An exact piece of the latest version (1 to 500 characters).
